title: ManhattanGrid P3 polish: coin-order, docstring, weak test assert, epsilon/index mismatch
description: From wave-4 3-perspective review (all P3): (1) mobility.py:901-903 Bernoulli coin drawn before pause_time_us<=0 guard - wasted draw per arrival when pausing impossible, reorder checks; (2) mobility.py:894-895 docstring claims PAUSED entries always have strictly positive remaining, false at exact-boundary exhaustion - fix wording; (3) test_manhattan_grid.py:545-547 test_zero_duration_pause_never_enters_paused asserts hypot>0 but should pin path_length==30.0 like sibling tests; (4) mobility.py:820 _on_grid_line epsilon can disagree with integer-index grid (public API self-inconsistency at float-degenerate extents; false negative at |coord|>~2e7 with sub-meter spacing) - align with index logic or document. All same file, one session.
